items.title: Fetch relay: routines read blocked hosts via a GitHub Actions fetch (docs/relay)
items.why: Four handoffs this week stalled only because the sandbox cannot reach ipo.gov.uk, nhs.uk, data.gov.uk, figma.com. A relay removes the whole class; the metrics routine gets Figma numbers too.
items.proof: handoffs citing 'no egress' drop to zero over the next 7 days; Figma metrics rows fill

items.title: Run watchdog: Telegram line when a scheduled routine leaves no commit/run-log line within 2h of its slot
items.why: The Wed 17:09 build was refused by the usage limit and nobody knew until the owner asked. Silence must be visible. Built 2026-09-25: scripts/run-watchdog.ts (+11 tests) appends one '| watchdog | missed:' RUNS line per silent slot; replayed against history it flags the 2026-09-23 17:00 build and nothing else. Only the workflow file is missing.
items.proof: every missed slot produces one 'missed' bullet within 2h
items.blocked_on: interactive session: `git mv docs/ci/run-watchdog.yml .github/workflows/` — routine tokens (git push and the GitHub API) lack the `workflow` scope, so no routine can add a workflow file

items.title: Weekly ops retro routine (Sonnet): reads RUNS/ALERTS/git log, proposes prompt and tooling fixes as foundry queue items
items.why: Owner 2026-09-24: self-expansion is in scope; nobody currently reviews how the routines themselves perform. Built 2026-09-26: prompt (docs/routines/ops-retro.md) measuring slot reliability, throughput, blockers by cause, routine defects and owner load, writing docs/retros/<year>-W<week>.md and queuing proposals ≥ 4 here; watchdog slot Sat 07:59 in scripts/run-watchdog.ts; trigger created from the routine but create_trigger sets no repository, so the validation firing (session cse_01FzQ9gN1R2KVqFD6hTCvva6) stalled in 'requires action' with 0 tokens; trigger left disabled.
items.proof: ≥ 2 accepted foundry items per month originate from the retro
items.blocked_on: interactive session: attach the repo giovf/rorororo to routine trig_015Uvn63XZUVqx1TAiWZrZL6 (routines UI or RemoteTrigger HTTP API) and enable it — or recreate it from docs/routines/ops-retro.md (Sonnet, `59 7 * * 6`) and delete the disabled one

items.title: Daily metrics routine fetches Figma/Chrome/AMO numbers through the relay instead of failing on egress
items.why: Every Figma row since launch says 'fetch failed: egress blocked'; no purchase/installs data at all. Done 2026-09-25: the metrics routine adopted the relay on its own (relay: metrics-2026-09-25, Figma versions API + plugin page fetched 200); the 2026-09-25 Variables Toolkit row reads 'via relay: install_count 0, like_count 0, view_count 2' — the proof number is in the row.
items.proof: Variables Toolkit metrics rows carry install/like numbers

items.title: Let routines add or change GitHub Actions workflows (a CI job that syncs docs/ci/*.yml into .github/workflows/ using an owner PAT with the workflow scope)
items.why: 2026-09-25: the build routine finished the run watchdog but could not create its workflow file — git push and the GitHub API both refuse without the `workflow` scope. Every self-expansion item that needs a scheduled job hits this; today it cost the item.
items.proof: a routine lands a new workflow without a handoff
items.blocked_on: owner: a fine-grained PAT (Contents + Workflows write on giovf/rorororo) stored as repo secret WORKFLOW_TOKEN — batch with the SAM key hand-over
